summary: Wednesday's session was split: calm, near-average volatility left equities range-bound while breadth thinned as defensives lagged growth. Bonds absorbed the day's sharpest sentiment hit as duration risk resurfaced even though short-term rate volatility eased. Gold stayed stuck in Fear despite a flat dollar, and crypto cooled from its recent surge but held the board's only Greed reading.
tweet: Bonds took the day's biggest sentiment hit on resurfacing duration risk, gold stayed stuck in Fear despite a flat dollar, and crypto cooled but held the only Greed on the board.
